# Bundled development dependency

`mini-figma-vite-0.1.0.tgz` is the existing MIT-licensed `@mini-figma/vite`
development editor package. It is stored here so a clean checkout can run
`npm ci` without a sibling `mini-figma` project. Its bytes and lockfile integrity
are unchanged from the previously referenced local archive.

When updating it, replace the archive and regenerate the lockfile together.
